actions.action: Move plant to a bright spot with 1-2 hours of direct morning sun
Every 3-4 days increase direct sun exposure by about an hour
Watch leaves for red-brown, bleached or crispy signs of sunburn
If leaves show sunburn, move back to shade for a few days then resume more slowly
Check soil dryness all the way down before watering
When soil is fully dry, soak and let excess drain
Set dropped leaves on dry soil to root into new plants

reason: The answer correctly treats the plant as healthy and needing sun acclimation, and its gradual exposure plan would likely also have kept it from burning, with nothing harmful advised.
